keeps safe low-cost behavior for non-text artwork
allows text-specific execution-cost spending when letter clarity improves
records explicit profile decisions for auditability
remaining_bottlenecks: QuickDraw line-art still has low strict precision because line running stitches need a dedicated line-art profile
